name: moatmap-data
title: MoatMap open data: decile tracker, monthly Best Stocks lists and covered companies
description: Out-of-sample decile returns for MoatMap's Quality, Value and Momentum ranking, the monthly top-25 lists by country, and the list of companies covered. Research data, not investment advice.

fields.name: regime_id

fields.name: scope
fields.description: investable (market cap >= $200M and >= $1M a day traded at formation) or full

fields.description: End of the return window (the next vintage)

fields.name: edition_date
fields.description: Month of the edition (the 1st)

fields.name: edition
fields.description: Country edition code (US, MY, JP, ...) or GLOBAL

fields.name: list
fields.description: moatmap_score for a country edition; GLOBAL has moatmap_score, quality_rank, value_rank, momentum_rank

fields.name: rank
fields.description: 1 to 25 within the list

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Yahoo Finance style ticker

fields.name: name
fields.description: Company name

fields.name: listing_market
fields.description: Market of the listing

fields.name: sector
fields.description: Sector

fields.name: moatmap_score
fields.description: Overall score, 0 to 100, percentile against every ranked company

fields.name: quality_rank
fields.description: Quality score, 0 to 100, against sector peers

fields.name: value_rank
fields.description: Value score, 0 to 100, against sector peers

fields.name: momentum_rank
fields.description: Momentum score, 0 to 100, against sector peers

fields.name: insider_buy
fields.description: Directors bought shares in the edition's window

fields.name: buyback
fields.description: The company bought back shares in the edition's window

fields.name: new_entry
fields.description: Not on the same list the month before; empty when the list has no earlier month

fields.name: why
fields.description: What drove the score; empty before September 2026

resources.name: companies
resources.description: Every company MoatMap covers, one row each, refreshed weekly from the week's Saturday scoring. Market cap of at least US$50M (US$25M in the UK and Canada, US$5M in Poland) and at least US$10K a day traded; no scores, caps or prices.

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Home listing, Yahoo Finance style ticker

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: Listed name

fields.name: native_name
fields.description: Name in its home script (KR, JP, CN, TW); empty elsewhere

fields.name: market
fields.description: Market code of the home listing (US, ES, MY, ...)

fields.name: market_name
fields.description: Market name

fields.name: country
fields.description: Where the company is based; can differ from the market

fields.name: sector
fields.description: Sector the company is scored in; for a not-ranked company, its data vendor sector, or empty

fields.name: other_listings
fields.description: The company's other lines on the site, separated by ;

fields.name: not_ranked
fields.description: fund, investment_company or preferred when listed but not ranked; empty for a ranked company
